pr.body:
## Claim
`CLM-SYLVA-MACRO-001` — **SYLVA PRIME / World Macro + Terrain + Regional Foundation**.

Agent: `AGENT-SYLVA-MACRO-01`  
Session: `20260912-SYLVA-MACRO-001`

### Includes
Metric local coordinate foundation; macro terrain/root network; Puerto del Injerto, Bosque de las Frases and Cámara de VESPER spatial foundations; primary traversal corridors; proxy root/membrane/scaffold language; Blender source/generator/GLB/evidence; blockout collision/streaming/LOD interfaces.

### Explicitly excludes
Final VESPER, NPCs, wildlife/vegetation species, final architecture/interiors, gameplay scripts, quests and other worlds.

### Collision audit
Branches and open PRs checked immediately before claim. Terra, Ares IX, Pelagos, Umbra, Khepri and Vanta were already occupied. No Sylva branch or open PR existed at claim time.

### Canon boundary
Planetary radius/diameter and several global planetary parameters are currently UNKNOWN in canon and will not be silently invented. Local authored space remains metre-scale and decoupled from unresolved L0 planetary metadata.

Current state: `CLAIMED / WAVE 0→1`. Do not merge until Blender, asset, QA and integration receipts required by the scope are present.

findings.finding: Published path sets are disjoint. Both claims include root/membrane structures and traversal/collision interfaces, so semantic duplication is possible. Root kit explicitly excludes full terrain/geography; macro excludes final species/architecture/materials. They can be complementary supplier and consumer.
findings.action: Keep both branches/projects. Macro owns regional composition, terrain, root centerlines, sockets and diagnostic proxies; root-kit owns reusable mesh generators, forks/junctions/walkways and root-attached anchor modules. Macro references kit asset IDs and does not independently promote proxy families to final kit assets.

findings.action: Normalize aliases SYLVA-PRIME / SYLVA PRIME / sylva -> canonical sylva before overlap comparison; preserve original field for provenance.
